notes:
The routing instinct is good. Amanda recognizes that a physical site inspection belongs with a human community manager and tells Grace she won’t have to repeat herself.
The issue is the diagnosis:
“A clogged or undersized common-area drain…”

The record only shows standing water at the drain. It does not establish that the drain is clogged or undersized. That is an unsupported inference stated too confidently.
She should say something like:
“The photos show standing water at the common-area drain, so we need someone on site to determine what’s causing it.”

That preserves the facts and avoids inventing the cause.
The execution question depends on the handoff package. She says:
“I’m sending this to her now…”

If the internal handoff package actually contains the photos/context and routes it to Martha, then execution is probably fine. If not, it’s another promise without real work behind it.
